events.title: Post-Match Press Scrutiny
events.description: Journalists ask whether the manager's tactical decisions cost the team points in the last match.

choices.text: Defend the manager publicly and emphasize collective squad responsibility.
Subtly hint that players weren't placed in roles to maximize their strengths.

events.title: Energy Drink Endorsement
events.description: A rising sports nutrition brand offers a quick sponsorship deal for an Instagram promotion.

choices.text: Sign the endorsement contract and shoot promotional content.
Decline the deal to keep your commercial image focused strictly on elite football.

events.title: Night Out Invitation
events.description: Teammates invite you to an exclusive VIP night out ahead of a mid-week training session.

choices.text: Attend the party and celebrate late into the night.

effects.description: Lack of sleep hits physical condition

choices.text: Politely decline, prepare a healthy meal, and sleep early.

events.title: Heated Locker Room Debate
events.description: Two senior players argue aggressively over defensive positioning during halftime analysis.

choices.text: Step in as a calm mediator and bring focus back to the team gameplan.
Keep your head down and stay out of the dispute.

events.title: Family Financial Request
events.description: A close family relative asks for financial assistance to help remodel their family home.

choices.text: Send the requested funds without hesitation.

effects.description: Peace of mind helping loved ones

choices.text: Explain that your finances need to remain invested in career stability.

effects.description: Felt guilty about having to say no

events.title: Solo Evening Training Session
events.description: After official training finishes, the fitness coach offers an optional extra 60-minute technical drill.

choices.text: Stay out on the grass and grind through the extra technical repetitions.

effects.description: Coaching staff noted exceptional work ethic

choices.text: Head straight inside to prioritize physical recovery.

events.title: Tabloid Gossip Story
events.description: A tabloid publishes misleading paparazzi photographs claiming you were out drinking past curfew.

choices.text: Release an official legal statement debunking the story.
Stay off social media and let your football do the talking on Saturday.

effects.description: Unanswered tabloid noise annoyed the club

events.title: Community Youth Foundation
events.description: The club foundation invites you to attend a grassroots football workshop for local school children.

choices.text: Spend your afternoon mentoring the kids and signing jerseys.

effects.description: Inspiring young fans lifted your spirits

choices.text: Pass on the event to rest at home.

events.title: Luxury Sports Car Offer
events.description: A luxury dealership offers you a lease package on an exotic performance sports car.

choices.text: Take the keys and drive the supercar to training ground gates.
Stick with your reliable daily vehicle and avoid vanity spending.

events.title: Agent Agitation
events.description: Your representative contacts you urging you to demand an improved wage packet or threaten a transfer.

choices.text: Tell your agent to be patient and focus strictly on performing well first.
Instruct the agent to aggressively push the board for higher terms.

effects.description: Asserted your value as a key player

events.title: Supporters Club Dinner
events.description: The official supporters club hosts their annual dinner and requests your presence as guest of honor.

choices.text: Attend the dinner, deliver a short speech, and connect with supporters.

effects.description: Felt the unconditional warmth of supporters

choices.text: Send an autographed match shirt and apologize for resting ahead of the weekend.

events.title: Family Weekend Visit
events.description: Your parents travel down to visit your apartment and watch you play this weekend.

choices.text: Take them out for a wonderful dinner and spend quality time together.
Keep the visit brief to maintain strict matchday focus.

effects.description: Wished you had spent more time with them

events.title: Cryotherapy & Recovery Center
events.description: A cutting-edge sports recovery clinic opens nearby offering specialized cryotherapy chambers.

choices.text: Book a full private cryotherapy and deep tissue massage session.
Use the club's standard plunge pool and save your personal money.

events.title: Locker Room Prank
events.description: A teammate hides your training boots on top of the locker room scoreboard.

choices.text: Take it with good humor and plot a creative harmless prank in return.

effects.description: Locker room camaraderie at all-time high

choices.text: Complain loudly that training gear should not be messed with.

effects.description: Let small antics get under your skin

events.title: Investment Opportunity Tip
events.description: A tech-savvy teammate tells you about a seed investment venture in an upcoming digital media platform.

choices.text: Commit £5,000 into the private investment round.
Pass on the high-risk opportunity and keep your money in standard savings.

events.title: Manager's Office Invitation
events.description: The manager calls you into his private office for an honest mid-season career evaluation.

choices.text: Listen humbly and ask what specific tactical details you can improve on.

effects.description: Manager delighted by your teachable attitude

choices.text: Argue that you deserve guaranteed starting minutes every week.

events.title: Boot Brand Showcase Event
events.description: A premier sports apparel brand invites you to trial prototype match boots ahead of the market release.

choices.text: Participate in the photo session and test the new prototypes.
Stay loyal to your current comfortable boots and skip the event.

events.title: Social Media Controversy
events.description: After a refereeing error, you are tempted to tweet your frustration with the match officials.

choices.text: Post your candid anger online and let fans know how you feel.

effects.description: Manager irritated by unnecessary disciplinary fine

choices.text: Delete the draft, put the phone down, and channel the emotion into next week's training.

events.title: Mid-Season Mental Fatigue
events.description: Relentless match schedules and intense physical pressure leave you feeling drained and irritable.

choices.text: Ask the coaching staff for a modified low-impact gym workout.
Refuse to show any signs of fatigue and complete the full training regimen.

effects.description: Pushed exhausted muscles to their absolute limit

events.title: Hometown Club Recognition
events.description: The local youth club where you first played as an 8-year-old names a youth tournament after you.

choices.text: Visit the tournament, hand out the trophy, and donate £1,500 in new gear.

effects.description: Charity donation to childhood grassroots club
Unforgettable joy giving back to roots

choices.text: Record a heartfelt video message to play on their social media page.
